enonce_intro_markdown:
![fig-1](gce-ol-maths-2020-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_15_fig_1.png)

Figure 5 is a bar chart showing 10 matches played and the number of goals scored per match by a certain team last football season. Find:

figures.legende: Figure 5 : diagramme en barres a quatre barres (etiquettes 2, 3, 1, 4 ; hauteurs 4, 3, 1, 2).

incertitudes: Question 15 : le diagramme est ambigu. Les axes sont etiquetes Goals (vertical) et Matches (horizontal, valeurs 2, 3, 1, 4), mais les hauteurs 4, 3, 1, 2 totalisent 10, ce qui correspond aux 10 matches de l'enonce. Le corrige lit donc les etiquettes comme nombres de buts par match et les hauteurs comme effectifs (a : 8 buts, b : 26 buts) ; la lecture litterale (match 2 : 4 buts, total 10 buts) est mentionnee en note pour (a) et (b). Reponse attendue par le jury incertaine.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the number of goals scored in two matches by the team.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Reading the chart: the horizontal axis gives the number of goals scored in a match ($2, 3, 1, 4$) and the height of each bar gives the number of matches (the heights $4 + 3 + 1 + 2 = 10$ add up to the $10$ matches played).

| Goals per match | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Number of matches | 1 | 4 | 3 | 2 |

The bar for $2$ goals has height $4$: the team scored $2$ goals in each of $4$ matches, that is $4 \times 2 = 8$ goals.

*Note on an alternative reading:* if the bars are read as printed (axes labelled "Goals" up and "Matches" along), match $2$ gives $4$ goals; but then the chart would show only $4$ matches, which contradicts the $10$ matches in the statement.

**Answer: 8 goals (in the $4$ matches in which $2$ goals were scored).**

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the total number of goals scored by the team last football season.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Total goals $= \sum (\text{goals} \times \text{number of matches})$:

$(1 \times 1) + (2 \times 4) + (3 \times 3) + (4 \times 2) = 1 + 8 + 9 + 8 = 26$.

**Answer: 26 goals** (over the $10$ matches). (Under the literal reading of the printed axes the total would instead be $4 + 3 + 1 + 2 = 10$ goals.)
